javax.microedition.theme
Class ElementFactory

java.lang.Object
  javax.microedition.theme.ElementFactory

public class ElementFactory
extends java.lang.Object

Creates elements to be used in themes and skins. An element created by this factory class can be either a standalone element or an element group. The return value of the creation method is a reference to an Element interface or one of its descendants.

Element instances created using this class are immutable.

All create methods must check for empty feature and role parameters and throw a java.lang.IllegalArgumentException if such parameters occur. If the implementation does not support modify operations, the methods in this class must throw ModifyNotSupportedException.

createElementGroup

public static Element createElementGroup(java.lang.String feature,
                                         java.lang.String role,
                                         Element[] initialElements)
                                  throws ElementException,
                                         ModifyNotSupportedException

Creates an element group with the specified feature and role, and with elements to be added to the group. The kind of the element group is always implicitly KIND_GROUP.

Empty element groups cannot be created. To create an element group, the standalone elements must be created first. All the element references in the initialElements array must be non-null, and they must have the same feature as the group. The role of each element in the group must be unique.

Parameters:
feature - the feature name
role - the role name within the feature
initialElements - the initial contents of the group
Returns:
the new element group
Throws:
ModifyNotSupportedException - if the implementation does not support modify operations
java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the initialElements array is empty, or if feature or role is empty
java.lang.NullPointerException - if any of the parameters is null, or the initialElements array contains one or more null Element references
ElementException - if the feature of one or more of the initial elements is different than the feature argument, or duplicate roles in initialElements

createFontElement

public static Element createFontElement(java.lang.String feature,
                                        java.lang.String role,
                                        java.lang.String name,
                                        int style,
                                        int size)
                                 throws ModifyNotSupportedException

Creates a font element with the specified name, style and pixel size. The kind of the created element is KIND_FONT.

The name is either the font face name or the font family name. The font style is a logical OR of the styles PLAIN, BOLD, ITALIC and UNDERLINED, as found in the MIDP 2.0 specification.

Parameters:
feature - the feature name
role - the role name
name - the font face or family name
style - the font style combination
size - the pixel size
Returns:
the new element
Throws:
ModifyNotSupportedException - if the implementation does not support modify operations
java.lang.NullPointerException - if feature, role or familyName is null
java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if feature or role or familyName is empty, if size is negative , or if style is not a valid combination of styles
